closing.title: Fiscal year closing
closing.description: Move income and expense balances to retained earnings, then lock the year. A close cannot be undone.
closing.empty: There are no fiscal years yet. Years appear once the first entry is posted.
closing.yearsHint: Choose an open year to preview its closing entry before closing it.

preview.title: Closing preview for {year}
preview.hint: This is what a close posts: every income and expense balance is reversed and the net goes to retained earnings.
preview.noLines: This year has no income or expense balances. Closing only locks the date, with no entry.

blockers.title: This year cannot be closed now
blockers.year_not_ended: The fiscal year has not ended yet.
blockers.has_drafts: There are draft entries in the year (count: {drafts}). Post or delete them first.
blockers.previous_year_open: Earlier fiscal years are still open. Close them first.
blockers.account_not_closable: Some accounts are archived or in a foreign currency and hold a balance.
blockers.no_retained_earnings_account: The company has no retained earnings account.
blockers.no_general_journal: The company has no miscellaneous journal.

errors.period_locked: The period is locked by a lock date, so the closing entry cannot be posted in it.

action.title: Close the year
action.hint: The year is ready to close. The closing entry is posted and the year is locked at its end date.
action.confirmDescription: The closing entry is posted and the year is locked. This cannot be undone.

zatca.title: E-invoicing (ZATCA)
zatca.description: Connect sales journals to ZATCA and follow the invoices still waiting.

backlog.title: Waiting invoices
backlog.hint: Invoices ZATCA has not accepted yet. Rejected and blocked ones need a manual correction.

journals.title: Sales journals
journals.hint: Each sales journal is connected to ZATCA once, with the one-time password of the Fatoora portal.

otp.label: One-time password (6 digits)
otp.help: You get it from the Fatoora portal when you add a new device. It expires quickly, so enter it right away.

onboard.confirmDescription: ZATCA is asked to issue a certificate for the journal with this password, and the action is recorded in the audit log.

errors.zatca_unavailable: ZATCA cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
errors.zatca_rejected: ZATCA rejected the request. Check the password and that it has not expired.
errors.zatca_local_error: The request failed before it reached ZATCA.
errors.zatca_unauthorized: ZATCA refused the journal certificate. Connect the journal again.
errors.zatca_mode_not_allowed: This environment is not allowed for onboarding in this phase.
errors.zatca_not_onboarded: The journal is not connected to ZATCA.
errors.zatca_not_applicable: This document is not a posted e-invoice.

audit.title: Finance audit log
audit.description: An immutable record of sensitive actions: who did them, when and on which record. Only field names are logged, never values.
audit.footer: Showing {shown} of {total} event | Showing {shown} of {total} events
audit.empty: There are no events in the log yet.
